name: Potion Stand Story
source:
WitchCon is calling! You and Elly are ready… if only you had 4000G.

No gold? No problem. Sell potions outside the dungeon and see if scrappy witches like you can make the money in time.

[From [url=https://doodlemancy.itch.io/potion-stand-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
巫师大会在召唤！你和Elly已经准备好了……只要你有4000G就好了。

没有金子？没问题。在地牢外面卖药水，看看像你这样好斗的女巫能否及时赚到钱。

[来自[url=https://doodlemancy.itch.io/potion-stand-story]Itch.io[/url]]
